items.entity: Design domain of the mid-load problem (whole structure or symmetric half)
items.description: Sec. 7.1.1 only says the design domain is 'shown in Fig. 6(a)'. Sec. 5 gives only the 100×100 element/pixel grid. The text never says whether this square grid is the whole structure or one symmetric half of a longer simply supported (MBB-type) beam loaded at mid-span. The default top88 problem, and the paper says top88 was used, is exactly such a half model.
readings: Whole structure: square domain L×L (1:1) meshed with 100×100 unit square elements
Symmetric half: the 100×100 square is the left half (or its mirror image) of a 2L×L simply supported beam loaded at mid-span, with a symmetry condition on the cut edge (default top88 MBB setup)

items.entity: Absolute domain size, element size and out-of-plane thickness
items.description: Sec. 5 gives only element counts (100×100). The text never states a physical length or height, element size, or plate thickness. If rmin=2.4 is read in element units and the load is a point load, these only scale the compliance.
readings: Unit square elements: domain 100×100 length units, thickness 1 (top88 convention)
Normalized domain 1×1 (element size 0.01), thickness 1
Physical dimensions, e.g. 1 m × 1 m with t = 0.01 m

items.description: Sec. 7.1.1: 'boundary conditions ... are shown in Fig. 6(a)'. No text says where the supports are or how far they extend (single nodes, whole edges or patches). The Fig. 8 and Table 1 target images, which might show this, are also unavailable.
readings: Two bottom corner nodes at (x/L, y/H) = (0, 0) and (1, 0)
Whole left edge x/L = 0 (symmetry line) plus the bottom-right corner node (1, 0) (top88 half-MBB)
Whole left and right edges x/L = 0 and x/L = 1
Short patches of a few nodes at both bottom corners

items.entity: Type of restraint at the supports
items.description: The text never says which degrees of freedom are fixed at each support (pin, roller, symmetry or clamp). Only Fig. 6(a) shows this (Sec. 7.1.1).
readings: Pin (ux=uy=0) at bottom-left + roller (uy=0) at bottom-right
Pins (ux=uy=0) at both bottom corners
Symmetry roller (ux=0) along the cut edge + vertical roller (uy=0) at the far bottom corner (top88 default)
Fully clamped (ux=uy=0) along both side edges

items.entity: Point where the mid-load is applied
items.description: Only the name 'Mid-load' (Fig. 6 caption, Sec. 7.1.1) and the unseen Fig. 6(a) locate the load. The text does not say which edge or point 'mid' refers to. It also does not say whether the load is the mid-span load of a full beam applied on the symmetry line of a half model.
readings: Mid-point of the top edge (x/L = 0.5, y/H = 1)
Mid-point of the bottom edge (x/L = 0.5, y/H = 0)
Centre of the domain (x/L = 0.5, y/H = 0.5)
Top-left corner node (x/L = 0, y/H = 1) of a half model, i.e. mid-span of the full beam (top88 default)

items.description: The text never says whether the load is a single nodal force or a load spread over a short segment or patch. Only Fig. 6(a) shows this.
readings: Single concentrated nodal force
Uniform load spread over a short segment (e.g. 2–5 nodes, a few % of L) centred at the load point

items.description: The load direction is not given in the text. It is only drawn in Fig. 6(a).
readings: Vertical downward (−y)
Vertical upward (+y); for this single-load linear compliance problem it gives the same layout as downward
Horizontal (±x)

items.description: No force value is stated anywhere (Secs. 4.1, 5, 7.1.1).
readings: |F| = 1 (unit load, top88 default)
Unit load on the full beam, i.e. F/2 = 0.5 at the symmetry-line node if a half model is used
A physical value, e.g. 1 kN

items.description: The text never says whether any elements are fixed solid or void (e.g. pads at the load or supports), and Fig. 6(a) cannot be checked.
readings: None: all 100×100 elements are design variables
Small solid non-design pad(s) under the load point and/or at the supports

items.entity: Young's modulus of the solid phase E1
items.description: Eq. (3) introduces E1 but no value is given anywhere.
readings: E1 = 1 (normalized; top88 default)
Physical value, e.g. 210 GPa (steel) or 70 GPa (aluminium)

items.entity: Young's modulus of the void phase E0 (ratio E0/E1)
items.description: Eq. (3) (modified SIMP) uses E0 for void elements, but no value or ratio is given.
readings: E0 = 1e-9·E1 (top88 Emin)

items.description: Poisson's ratio is not mentioned anywhere in the text (Sec. 4 gives only the SIMP interpolation).
readings: ν = 0.3 (top88 default)

items.entity: 2D stress state (plane stress or plane strain)
items.description: Sec. 4 only says 'bi-linear quadrilateral finite elements'. It does not say plane stress or plane strain. Switching between them is equivalent to changing the effective Poisson's ratio.
readings: Plane stress with unit thickness (top88 element stiffness)
Plane strain

items.description: Sec. 5 gives only penal=3, rmin=2.4 and ft=1 as top88 inputs. The update algorithm and its parameters (move limit, damping) are never stated.
readings: Optimality Criteria with move limit 0.2, damping exponent 0.5 and bisection on the volume multiplier (top88 default)
MMA with standard settings

items.description: Sec. 5 lists maxit=100 only for TOPress. For the top88 runs (mid-load) no iteration cap or convergence tolerance is given.
readings: Stop when max |Δρ| < 0.01, with no iteration cap (top88 default)
Fixed cap of 100 iterations (as listed for TOPress)
Tighter tolerance, e.g. max |Δρ| < 0.001

items.description: The starting density field is not specified anywhere (Secs. 4, 5, 7.1.1).
readings: Uniform ρ = V* (top88 default)
Uniform ρ = 0.5
Uniform ρ = 1
